projects.title: FX Checker
projects.bodyText: - Modern currency exchange application featuring real-time conversion, market dashboard with historical charts, currency comparison tools, and persistent favorites. Built with Angular 19 and the latest Signals API.

projects.title: Pokédex Search
projects.bodyText: - Pokémon search engine with advanced filters, smart pagination, and sorting — pulling data from the PokéAPI. Includes detailed Pokémon profile pages with stats, types, and evolution chains.

projects.title: Aesthetic Clinic Manager
projects.bodyText: - Full-featured clinic management system covering patient records, stock control, appointment scheduling, and administrative reports — developed as a capstone project during graduation.
